name: serpapi_walmart_product
description: Get details and reviews for one Walmart product: pictures, price/currency, ratings/review count, specifications, seller offers, variants and reported stock/shipping/pickup/delivery when available. Use for 'tell me more about the second Walmart product', 'what do its reviews say', or a Walmart.com product URL. Reuse the product_id and store_id from saved Walmart search candidates; numeric us_item_id also works. The product API supports US Walmart.com only. Individual review excerpts and availability are limited to what Walmart returns for the selected location. One cached SerpApi product request; no purchases.

product_id.description: Walmart product_id from search (prefer alphanumeric ID), numeric us_item_id, or Walmart.com /ip/ product URL. Reuse saved search ID and store_id; do not repeat search to look up a selected product.

store_id.description: Explicit Walmart store ID for local prices/availability; overrides all location defaults.

postal_code.description: Optional US ZIP override; otherwise uses configured Walmart store or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE. Exact ZIP-to-store lookup only; unmatched ZIP is explicitly reported, never treated as local availability.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi cache. Default false; exact cached responses are free.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
